summary: Moolec Science SA filed a Form 6-K updating its financial support and liquidity situation. The company faces a going-concern uncertainty due to negative working capital and the expiration of shareholder support, worsened by a winding-up petition from Linklaters LLP regarding a disputed $2.3 million legal fee claim from former management. Current management and board dispute the debt and are seeking replacement financing and defending against the petition. The filing describes ongoing cost-reduction restructuring measures and signals potential further legal actions. Watch for financing developments and petition resolution outcomes.
